items.item_text: 01. Do you hold a current American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (AART) certification and registration or the equivalent*, in radiography? *Equivalent: an unrestricted state license for the state in which the program is located. NOTE: License, certification, or registration information must be clearly stated in the application. Options: Yes | No
Holds current American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (AART) certification and registration.
Have a bachelor’s degree AND two years of occupational and/or professional experience directly related to the teaching assignment;
have an associate’s degree, AND six years of occupational and/or professional experience directly related to the teaching assignment;
, the equivalent.* All degrees must be from an accredited institution and completed by date of hire.

Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment.
